newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bund gains above 101.67 hard to sustain.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bund gains above 101.67 hard to sustain.

text.p: June Bund futures will have a hard time pushing much beyond resistance at 101.61,67 on Friday as international debt markets gear up for U.S. payroll data later in the session, technical analysts said.
A landslide win by the Labour Party in Britain will steal a lot of the attention while holidays on the continent on Thursday will likely mean thin trade, dealers said.

"We think that 101.61 which is the Fib target is probably not going to hold," Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London said. "The hourly indicator is looking overbought and the daily one is getting up towards that area."
Resistance at 101.61 comes from a 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement of the decline from 103.16 in late February to 99.05 on April 3. It was also the high on March 17 before the market slid down.
June Bund futures on LIFFE closed at 101.67 on Thursday from an opening of 101.47.
Whitby added there were more problems around the 102.00 area an area of supply.
Analysts at Chase in London also expected some consolidation.

"Given the strong trendline resistance intervening at 101.86, 101.97 and finally at 102.18 some consolidative price action is anticipated before the long term uptrend is resumed," they said in a research note.
Whitby put initial support this session at 101.54,56.

"That was a buying area yesterday afternoon where it kept finding support and obviously a break there would be a sign we are getting a crack and sellers are coming in below this 102.00 area," she said.
Below there, the next target would be 101.24 to 101.07, an area of previous congestion, Whitby said.
Daily charts show the market hitting a 101.07 high on April 29 before it vaulted higher.
In between, there was a bit of support at 101.32, Thursday's low, Whiby added.
At the short end, June Euromarks closed at 96.78 on Thursday.
